recentItems.title: Brown Mogotsi case postponed
recentItems.description:
The case against self-proclaimed political fixer Brown Mogotsi has been postponed in the Johannesburg Magistrate's Court.

This after the defence asked the state for further particulars, including the cellular telephone records of state witnesses.

Mogotsi is facing charges including unlawful possession of a firearm, perjury and defeating the ends of justice, linked to an alleged staged assassination attempt in Vosloorus last year.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Home Affairs Min. Leon Schreiber on government services
recentItems.description:
Home Affairs Minister Leon Schreiber is promising a major shift in how South Africans access government services. 

He has also outlined plans for the future of the department. He was speaking at the launch of Home Affairs’ Quantum Leap vision at Constitution Hill in Johannesburg. 

He says more than 500 bank branches are now being used to provide Home Affairs services, while Smart ID replacement and the electronic travel authorisation system are also being digitised. #SABCNews #SouthAfrica #sabcnewsonline #fyp #Gauteng #homeaffairs

recentItems.title: Brown Mogotsi in Court for unlawful possession of a firearm, perjury, defeating the ends of justice
recentItems.description:
Brown Mogotsi is expected back in the Johannesburg Magistrates' Court this morning, after being denied bail for the fourth time. The matter is expected to move closer to trial proceedings, with the possibility of being transferred to the High Court. Mogotsi faces charges including unlawful possession of a firearm, discharging a firearm in a built-up area, perjury and defeating the ends of justice. Lets bring in SABC News Reporter, Chriselda Lewis for the latest...

recentItems.title: Brown Mogotsi back in court after being denied bail for the fourth time
recentItems.description:
The State is expected to continue its cross-examination of North West businessman and alleged political fixer Brown Mogotsi in his bail application on new facts when the case resumes in the Johannesburg Magistrates court today.  

Mogotsi faces several charges including unlawful possession of a firearm and ammunition, discharging a firearm in a built-up area, defeating or obstructing the administration of justice, and perjury.
